PSI-AI is a working group of the [HUPO Proteomics Standards Initiative](https://www.psidev.info) (HUPO-PSI). The documents below describe how the working group is organized and what is expected of everyone who takes part in it.

- [**Working group charter**](charter/index.qmd): the working group's purpose, goals, and chairs.
- [**Code of conduct**](code-of-conduct/index.qmd): expected behavior in all PSI-AI community spaces, and how to report a violation.
